definitions.explanation: to feel peaceful; to relax; to feel calm and comfortable

examples.japanese: {音楽|おんがく}を{聴|き}くと{気持|きも}ちが{安|やす}らぐ。
examples.english: Listening to music makes me feel at ease.

examples.japanese: {自然|しぜん}の{中|なか}にいると{心|こころ}が{安|やす}らぐ{時間|じかん}を{過|す}ごせる。
examples.english: Being in nature allows me to spend peaceful time where my heart feels at ease.

notes:
{安|やす}らぐ is an intransitive godan verb expressing a state of inner peace and tranquility.

TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive ({自動詞|じどうし}). The transitive counterpart is {安|やす}らげる (to soothe, give comfort).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {心|こころ}が{安|やす}らぐ (one's heart feels at peace)
- {気持|きも}ちが{安|やす}らぐ (to feel at ease)
- {安|やす}らぎを{感|かん}じる (to feel peace/comfort)
- {安|やす}らぎの{時間|じかん} (peaceful time)

RELATED NOUN:
{安|やす}らぎ is the nominalized form meaning "peace, comfort, tranquility."

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {落|お}ち{着|つ}く: To calm down (from an agitated state)
- リラックスする: To relax (more physical)
- {安|やす}らぐ: Emphasizes inner peace and emotional comfort

REGISTER: Neutral to slightly literary. Common in written contexts and poetic expressions.
